input.label: bug
input.reply:
Thanks for the report and the StackBlitz repro. You describe a change from v3 to v4: projects used to run one after another and now interleave. That change isn't in the migration guide, so it's unclear whether it was intended.

I couldn't search existing issues or the source from here, so I haven't checked for a duplicate or confirmed the cause. A maintainer will need to check whether the scheduling change was deliberate. That includes how `fileParallelism: false` and `maxWorkers: 1` interact with multiple projects when `isolate: false` is set.

Until then, `sequence.groupOrder` is the only documented way to force project order, as you noted. Your suggested `projectParallelism: false` flag is a reasonable follow-up request if the new behavior turns out to be intended.

It would help to know whether v4 interleaves projects even with a single worker, and the last v4 release where the old order held, if you've bisected it.
